scope: Next spell/modal/splice capture boundary needed for complete retarget behavior; does not presume pending modal qualification success.
findings: CastModalContinuationResumer.resumeCastModalTargetSelection sorts requirement keys and flattens them at161-165 before storing per-mode flat targets. Capture original groups here before loss.
CastModalTargetSelectionContinuation retains baseCastAction, chosenModeIndices, currentOrdinal and per-mode flat targets; provenance needs its own ordinal-preserving continuation payload.
CastSpellHandler.presentCastModalTargetDecision includes targetless modes and generates requirement-indexed decisions; finalizeModalCast flattens again and re-enters execute with a copied CastSpell.

Accepted-source trace narrows the earlier payment-pause assumption: CastPaymentProcessor returns PaymentResult synchronously. Actual pre-stack pauses in CastSpellHandler are modal selection, unpaid additional-cost selection, and creature-type choice after payment. Do not invent a general spell-mana continuation.

CastSpell is a serialized public action in GameAction.kt. Do not trust arbitrary client-supplied object-reference history added to it. Choose an internal source-bound carrier and prove validation/serialization boundaries before implementation.

CastSpellHandler sends modal fields, damage allocations and spliced names to protected StackResolver.castSpell. Do not change that boundary; inspect safe post-cast attachment and every pause/resume before choosing a design.
Existing ordinary and choose-one modal inputs may already be flat; they cannot establish omitted original groups. Leave untracked history explicit rather than reconstructing it from counts.
Splice requirements are appended in declared spliced-card order; new capture must retain the source text identity and requirement offset as well as modal ordinal.
ClientMessage.SubmitAction directly contains GameAction. Keep public serialized CastSpell free of trusted object-reference history; an externally supplied ordinary action must enter with no capture.

ContinuationHandler.resume validates decision identity and pops the owned suspension before dispatch. Modal and additional-cost cancellation return that popped state with restored priority; continuation-local provenance would disappear naturally without a card-attached cleanup side channel.
Additional-cost collection merges the action and recursively calls execute, including a synchronous forced-selection path; both edges must explicitly preserve an internal capture argument.

After synchronous mana payment, pauseForCreatureTypeChoice carries a separate CastWithCreatureTypeContinuation. Its resumer calls protected StackResolver.castSpell directly. A post-cast attachment implemented only in CastSpellHandler would miss this branch.

Both success-return sites offer an unprotected post-cast attachment seam before trigger/priority processing. Attach only when cast succeeds and the expected spell stack component exists; preserve existing events and do not recapture visits after payment.

All six additional reviewed files match accepted-source Git blobs and local SHA-256. CastSpellHandler, CastSpellAdditionalCostContinuation, ColorAndTypeContinuations, ModalAndCloneContinuationResumer and ContinuationHandler are absent from the frozen144-binding map; StackResolver remains protected.
